home.title: Overview
paragraphs: The overview shows all children and their current balance at a glance.
Active savings goals appear right on the card, so you can see how far each child has already come.
From here, one tap takes you to the child's account.

wallet.title: Child account
paragraphs: The child account shows a child's currently available pocket money.
Income increases the balance, expenses reduce it. Every movement is recorded, so you can always see how the balance has developed.
The child account is the heart of the app and brings together all of a child's important information in one place.

allowances.title: Allowance rules
paragraphs: Allowance rules make regular payments automatically.
That way you don't have to remember when the allowance is due. The balance is increased automatically at the chosen time.
Rules are ideal for recurring allowance payments and keep the balance always up to date.

goals.title: Savings goals
paragraphs: Savings goals make bigger wishes visible.
Children see not only their balance, but also how close they are to something they want.
Progress is calculated automatically from the current balance and grows with every deposit.

activity.title: Activity
paragraphs: Activity sums up the most important recent changes.
This lets you quickly see whether the balance has recently gone up or down, without reading the whole transaction history.
It gives you a quick look at the current trend.

transactions.title: Transactions
paragraphs: Transactions record every change to the balance.
They form the account's history and make it clear when money was added or spent.
This way, changes can always be traced.

earn.title: Income
paragraphs: Income increases a child's available balance.
Use it for things like pocket money, gifts, rewards or other extra amounts.
Every income entry is automatically recorded in the history.

spend.title: Expenses
paragraphs: Expenses reduce the available balance.
Use them when a child pays for something with their pocket money or buys something they wanted.
This keeps the history easy to follow at all times.

admin.title: Management
paragraphs: Management contains rarely used app settings.
While everyday use happens directly in the child's account, this is where you'll find app-wide features such as managing children, PIN settings, appearance options and backups.
Management is for organising the app, not for day-to-day pocket money tasks.

children.title: Children
paragraphs: All existing children are managed here.
You can add new children and remove existing ones.
Everyday use then happens directly in each child's account.

settings.title: Settings
paragraphs: Settings contain general app options.
These include the optional PIN protection as well as other basic configuration.
Changes apply to the whole app.

appearance.title: Appearance
paragraphs: Appearance determines how the app looks.
Colours, theme options and language can be adjusted to personal preferences without changing how the app works.
These settings apply to the entire user interface.

currency.title: Currency symbol
paragraphs: The currency symbol appears wherever amounts are shown.
This way, balances, transactions and savings goals match the currency your family actually saves in.
The amounts themselves stay the same – only how they're displayed changes.

pin.title: PIN
paragraphs: PIN protection is optional. When it is enabled, the app asks for the PIN before changes to balances, children or allowance rules and locks the management area.
Children can view their account at any time, but with PIN protection they can’t record amounts, change rules or delete children.
Without PIN protection, these actions are carried out directly. Confirmations for deleting or restoring remain in place.

theme.title: Colour scheme
paragraphs: The colour scheme sets whether the app is shown in light or dark mode.
“System” automatically follows your device’s setting and changes along with it, for example switching to dark mode in the evening.
“Light” and “Dark” fix the display regardless of the device.

accentColor.title: Accent colour
paragraphs: The accent colour gives the app its personal touch.
It highlights important buttons and progress without changing the children's colours.

language.title: Language
paragraphs: The language setting determines which language all app texts are shown in.
By default, the device language is used. A manual choice takes priority and is remembered.
Your data such as names, descriptions and savings goals stays unchanged when switching.

backup.title: Backup
paragraphs: Backups protect children, transactions, savings goals and rules from being lost.
All data is stored only on this device. With a backup, everything can be fully restored after switching devices, reinstalling or accidental deletion.
It's safest to keep the file outside the device, for example in cloud storage or on a computer.
